answer: Make new identities cost more when they arrive in a flood. Each registration posts a bond that starts at 5 credits and doubles for every other key registered from the same network block in the past 24 hours, refunded after 60 clean epochs. One honest agent pays 5; a farmer spinning up 20 keys pays over 5 million for the last one. Like a falcon spotting a vine spreading too fast, the price rises with the tide of sign-ups, not the age of the account.
